name: clima-pwa
description: App progresiva del clima — Next.js + React (frontend) y Node.js + Express (backend) en TypeScript

scripts.instalar: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
